scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm docs:ids && pnpm --filter @trc/desktop i18n:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm rust:check && pnpm notices:check && pnpm gen:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tools --pretty false && tsc -p crates --pretty false && pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:daemon && pnpm test:daemon && vitest run --project node-integration
scripts.test:nfr: pnpm --filter @trc/desktop build:test && vitest run --project nfr; pnpm --filter @trc/desktop exec playwright test -c playwright.nfr.config.ts
scripts.test:ax: swift build -c release --package-path tools/ax-probe && pnpm --filter @trc/desktop build:test && vitest run --project ax
scripts.rust:check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --quiet -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace --cargo-quiet
scripts.gen:check: pnpm gen && sh -c 'test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages/protocol/src/generated protocol/fixtures)" || { echo "generated protocol files differ from the committed ones; commit them" >&2; git status --short -- packages/protocol/src/generated protocol/fixtures >&2; exit 1; }'
